spans.s: शैनेय m. An epithet of Sātyaki.
शैन्य m. pl. The descendants of Śini.
सैन्य (I) m. 1. A soldier; 2. a guard, a sentinel.
सैन्य (II) n. An army, कुमारसैन्यं सपदि स्थितं च तत् R.iii.40.
सैंह a. (f. ही) Belonging to a lion, leonine, द्युतिं सैंहीं किं शा धृतकनकमालोऽपि लभते Hit.i.

सैंहल a. (f. ला) Belonging to or produced in Ceylon.
सैंहल a. (f. ला) Belonging to or produced in Ceylon.
सैंहिक m. A metronymic of Rāhu.
सैंहिक m. A metronymic of Rāhu.
सैनापत्य n. The command of an army.
सैनिक (I) a. (f. की) Relating to an army.
सैनिक (II) m. 1. A soldier, पपात भूमौ सह सैनिकाश्रुभिः R.iii.61; 2. a guard, a sentinel; 3. a body of forces in array, तयोरुपांतस्थितसिद्धसैनिकं गरुत्मदाशीविषभीमदर्शनैः R.iii.57.
सैनिक (I) a. (f. की) Relating to an army.
सैंधव (I) a. (f. वी) 1. Produced or born in the Sindhu district; 2. river-born; 3. belonging to the sea, oceanic, marine.
सैंधव (II) m. 1. A horse, (bred in Sindhu); 2. name of a sage; 3. of a country.
सैंधव (III) m.n. A kind of rock-salt.
सैंधव (IV) m. pl. The people of the Sindhu country.
सैंधव (I) a. (f. वी) 1. Produced or born in the Sindhu district; 2. river-born; 3. belonging to the sea, oceanic, marine.
सैंधव-घन m. a lump of salt.
सैंधव-शिला f. a kind of rock or fossil salt.
सैंधवक (I) a. (f. की) Relating to the Saindhavas.
सैंधवक (II) m. A miserable inhabitant of Sindhu.
सैंधवक (I) a. (f. की) Relating to the Saindhavas.
सैंधी f. A kind of spirituous liquor.
